bullets.text: Virgin Media O2 Activates 5G SA - **O2** launches 5G Standalone in Manchester, enhancing connectivity for over 589,000 residents.
Fractile's £100m Investment - UK government backs **Fractile**'s expansion to boost the AI hardware ecosystem.
AI-RRM Enhances Wi-Fi 7 - **AI-RRM** optimizes Wi-Fi 7 networks for better performance in high-density environments.
Private 5G Market Matures - **Vodafone Business** reports nearly 200 private 5G deployments, signaling market readiness to scale.
Samsung's AI-Ready Networks - **Samsung** reveals strategies for building AI-capable networks on existing infrastructure.
6G's Sensing Infrastructure - Future **6G** networks may integrate sensing capabilities, transforming connectivity into situational awareness.
BT Group Leadership Changes - **BT Group** announces executive shifts at Openreach and BT International to enhance strategic focus.
WPA3 Security Challenges - Adoption of **WPA3** in multi-dwelling units faces significant interoperability issues.
GreenMed Subsea Cable Project - **Sparkle** and partners to build a new subsea cable enhancing connectivity between Europe and the Middle East.
AI in Network Management - **Intent-Based Networking** leverages AI to simplify network management through natural language commands.
